title: Cinder
summary: CINDER, noun 1. Small coals or particles of fire mixed with ashes; embers. 2. Small particles of matter, remaining after combustion, in which fire is extinct; as the cinders of a forge.

inlines.v: CINDER, noun 1. Small coals or particles of fire mixed with ashes; embers. 2. Small particles of matter, remaining after combustion, in which fire is extinct; as the cinders of a forge.
